objective: Validate M5 revision-pinned OpenTag3D/OpenPrintTag read-only conversion and Spoolman import/export/profile-sync implementation.
owner_requirements: Read and convert OpenPrintTag and OpenTag3D before considering writes
Do not weaken existing OpenSpool/PAXX write safety or user data preservation
change_summary: Android NFC routing and conversion UI
OkHttp server profile sync with create/update/failure tests
architecture_decisions: External tag adapters are read-only and return the complete raw payload plus warnings
OpenTag3D pinned to 2.000 revision d0f70689; newer major is read-only
OpenPrintTag pinned to 7e09cc38 with bounded CBOR, key 61 micrometres, legacy key 30 millimetres, and official fixture
Android reader enables NFC-A and NFC-V; NDEF may contain unrelated URI records but multiple filament MIME records are rejected
Spoolman imports official flattened exports and nested API responses; exports flattened shape
Live sync is profile-only and uses stable external IDs; physical spool creation is excluded because Spoolman has no spool external ID
Mutation transport loss is UNKNOWN and never automatically retried
Cleartext HTTP is enabled for local Spoolman prototypes and disclosed; no Spoolman credentials are handled

physical_external_tags.OpenTag3D: NOT RUN - no physical formatted tag supplied
physical_external_tags.OpenPrintTag: NOT RUN - no physical NFC-V tag supplied

objective_evidence.live_spoolman_server: NOT RUN - no server URL supplied; mock transport create/update/failure tests pass
objective_evidence.unrelated_state: A user editor swap file beside .env.local was preserved and excluded.

known_limits: No physical OpenTag3D or OpenPrintTag tag was available, so radio-path hardware acceptance remains open and documented
No live Spoolman server URL was supplied, so real server mutation was not run
External format write/verify is unsupported by design
review_questions: Are binary/CBOR semantics and future/unknown preservation correct?
Does NFC routing preserve existing write safety and actual Android NFC-A/NFC-V behavior?
Are Spoolman flattened export and API sync contracts correct at the pinned revision?
Can partial failures create duplicates or false success?
Are cleartext, UI, lifecycle, performance, accessibility, or provenance risks material?
Report normalized findings with severity, evidence, correction, acceptance test and confidence.
sanitization: No credentials, environment values, user database contents, NFC UIDs, device serials, network addresses, photos, or account data are included.
